system.description:
You swipe your hand releasing a massive surge of Draconic chakra serrating everything in range. Make a melee Ninjutsu attack comparing the result vs the AC of all creatures in range. On a hit, affected creatures take [Unarmed Damage] (Or [Weapon Damage]) + 2d8 damage.

If this attack result is 5 or more over the AC of the affected creature, they must make a Strength saving throw to resist having their guard shattered, making the next attack targeting them, before the beginning of your next turn be made at advantage.

Dragons Rage. If this jutsu is cast while in your Dragon Rage State, if an affected creature would cast a jutsu with the Barrier keyword, that barriers hit points, DR or AC bonus is reduced by half. At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the size of the cone by 5 feet and the damage by 1d8 damage.
